description: Fixed-capacity resource experiments. Historical paths refer to artifacts at measurement time. Final stock rebuilt candidate is source72c6263; earlier async and batching candidates were rejected. Rows include warmups; no row was excluded as an outlier. Raw parsed values are preserved. Source-file hashes cover original formatting.
limits: CPU0 affinity and100000/100000 cgroup quota, unchanged release flags, warm page cache, private fixtures, explicit best-effort enforcement. Sequential RSS samples are not a simultaneous combined peak; wait4 ru_maxrss is not summed process-tree RSS. No universal resource-neutrality claim.

provenance.cgroup_semantics: Dedicated container cpu.stat delta from immediately before client fork to immediately after composer, including harness and helpers. memory.peak is cumulative for this container, not a per-trial startup peak.
provenance.cpu_semantics: Client and separate live daemon process utime+stime+cutime+cstime at composer. Warm daemon subtracts snapshot immediately before client launch; cold daemon is replacement lifetime. Child counters include only waited children; live helper CPU is not a process-tree census. Client wait4 is separately reported through post-timing durable admission and termination.
provenance.memory_semantics: VmRSS and VmHWM sampled at composer, per process. Warm daemon HWM includes fixture seeding. Client wait4 peak includes post-timing admission. No claim of simultaneous combined peak.
provenance.cold_fixture: real saved session and catalogue; fixture daemon stopped before timed client autostart
provenance.endpoint: real selected-session attached composer; first frame recorded separately
provenance.input_admission: PTY prompt committed as new durable user-turn entry after timer; unreachable synthetic provider

provenance.endpoint: real selected-session attached composer; first frame recorded separately
provenance.input_admission: PTY prompt committed as new durable user-turn entry after timer; unreachable synthetic provider
